title: Password Reset Policy
text: Employees must reset passwords via the IT portal. Identity verification is required. Never share passwords. For urgent lockouts, call the help desk.

title: Visitor Policy (General)
text: Visiting hours are 10am–8pm. After-hours visitors require unit approval. Visitors must follow PPE signage and screening.

title: PPE Requirements (ICU)
text: ICU requires mask and hand hygiene. Isolation rooms require gown and gloves per posted signage. Staff must follow unit protocols.

title: PHI Access and Privacy
text: PHI access is limited to authorized workforce members for job duties. Do not disclose patient information. Report incidents to privacy office.
